title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree Signatures To The Qurans Heavenly Origin

questions.question: Who is called the source of Islam and the one who explains the Qur'an in this passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: How did he feel about the Qur'an compared with other people?
questions.answer: He honored it more than everyone else and believed in it very strongly.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his own words compared with the Qur'an?
questions.answer: His own speech was not like the Qur'an and did not come close to it.

questions.question: What kinds of things did he tell about through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He told true things about the past and the future.

questions.question: From where were those past and future things hidden?
questions.answer: They were hidden from normal human sight and knowledge.

questions.question: While many people watched him closely, what was not found in him?
questions.answer: No trick or fault was found in him.

questions.question: What does his strong trust in every message of the Qur'an show?
questions.answer: It shows that the Qur'an is truly from Allah.

questions.question: About how much of humanity does the passage say is drawn to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: About one-fifth, and even more than that.

questions.question: How do those people listen to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They listen carefully and want the truth.

questions.question: Besides people, which other beings are said to gather when the Qur'an is recited?
questions.answer: Jinn, angels, and spirit beings.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how those beings gather around it?
questions.answer: They are compared to moths going around a light.

questions.question: What do the love and attention of people and other beings show about the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They show that it is accepted widely and has a very high place.

questions.question: What two big ideas are used in this passage as signs of the Qur'an's truth?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s strong belief in it and the way many beings turn to it.

questions.question: How sure was the Prophet about the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He was completely sure and never shaky about it.

questions.question: What happened to him when revelation came, according to the passage?
questions.answer: He was in a sleep-like state.

questions.question: Why is it important that his regular speech was different from the Qur'an?
questions.answer: It helps show the Qur'an was not made up by him.

questions.question: What kind of events did he speak about with confidence through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Real events from long ago and events still to come.

questions.question: What does the passage ask us to notice about people watching him?
questions.answer: Even careful watchers did not find cheating or mistakes in him.

questions.question: If a person keeps trusting a message with full strength, what does that tell us here?
questions.answer: It tells us he knew it was true and from Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say many people do with the Qur'an in their religion?
questions.answer: They hold tightly to it and follow it.

questions.question: What does eager listening tell us about their hearts?
questions.answer: They truly want guidance and truth.

questions.question: Name two groups besides humans that are said to gather around the Qur'an.
questions.answer: Angels and jinn.

questions.question: When do those beings gather around it?
questions.answer: When it is recited.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage make from all this?
questions.answer: The Qur'an is accepted by creation and has a very honored rank.

questions.question: Who is the interpreter of the Qur'an mentioned here?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What was special about his respect for the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He respected it more than anyone else.

questions.question: Did the passage present his own speech as equal to the Qur'an or different from it?
questions.answer: Different from it.

questions.question: Why does that difference matter in the passage?
questions.answer: It supports that the Qur'an is from Allah, not from his own words.

questions.question: What unseen time periods did he speak truly about through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Times before and times after his own day.

questions.question: What can we infer from no fault being seen in him under close watching?
questions.answer: He was truthful and trustworthy.

questions.question: What kind of mark or sign is his belief in the Qur'an called?
questions.answer: A seal or stamp that confirms it.

questions.question: What part of mankind does the passage say is tied to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: A fifth of mankind, even more than that.

questions.question: What do they do when they hear it?
questions.answer: They listen eagerly.

questions.question: Which unseen beings are also said to gather around it?
questions.answer: Jinn, angels, and spirit beings.

questions.question: What does their gathering tell us about the Qur'an?
questions.answer: It shows it is honored and welcomed by many kinds of beings.

questions.question: What is the main message of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Qur'an is true, from Allah, and greatly accepted.

questions.question: In this passage, whose faith is used as proof for the truth of the Qur'an?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad’s faith.

questions.question: How strong was his faith in the Qur'an?
questions.answer: It was very strong and firm.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his confidence when speaking through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: He spoke without doubt.

questions.question: Were the things he told about easy for ordinary people to know?
questions.answer: No, they were hidden from normal people.

questions.question: What kinds of hidden things did he tell about?
questions.answer: Things from the past and the future.

questions.question: What was the result when sharp-eyed people watched him closely?
questions.answer: They still found no deceit or flaw in him.

questions.question: What does that teach us about his character?
questions.answer: He was honest and reliable.

questions.question: What large group of people does the passage mention as being drawn to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: More than a fifth of all people.

questions.question: What do these people want when they listen to it?
questions.answer: They want the truth.

questions.question: What other creatures are mentioned as gathering near the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Jinn, angels, and spirit beings.

questions.question: How are they described as gathering?
questions.answer: In a loving and worshipful way.

questions.question: Put the final idea in simple words: what do all these signs show?
questions.answer: They show the Qur'an is true and has a very high place.

questions.question: According to the passage, who believed in the Qur'an most strongly?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: How did his respect for the Qur'an compare with everyone else’s?
questions.answer: His respect was greater than everyone else’s.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his condition when revelation came?
questions.answer: He was in a sleep-like condition.

questions.question: How was the Qur'an different from his other speeches?
questions.answer: His other speeches were not like it and did not match it.

questions.question: What truthful news did he give through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: News about the past and the future.

questions.question: Why is it important that no cheating was seen in him?
questions.answer: It helps prove he was speaking the truth.

questions.question: What did nothing manage to do to his faith in the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Nothing made it weak or shaky.

questions.question: What does his steady faith act like in the passage?
questions.answer: A sign that the Qur'an is revelation from Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say about many humans and the Qur'an?
questions.answer: Many are attracted to it and tied to it in faith.

questions.question: How do they hear it?
questions.answer: With eagerness and a desire for truth.

questions.question: Which non-human beings also gather around it when it is recited?
questions.answer: Jinn, angels, and spirit beings.

questions.question: What does the gathering of humans and other beings show together?
questions.answer: It shows the Qur'an is greatly accepted and highly honored.

questions.question: What person in the passage helps confirm that the Qur'an is true?
questions.answer: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: Give one reason from the passage why he helps confirm it.
questions.answer: He believed in it with all his strength.

questions.question: Give another reason from the passage about his speech.
questions.answer: His normal words were not like the Qur'an.

questions.question: What kind of matters did he explain through the Qur'an?
questions.answer: True matters about the unseen past and future.

questions.question: What does the passage say people could not find in him, even when watching carefully?
questions.answer: Any trick, dishonesty, or fault.

questions.question: If someone stays firm and never wavers, what does that show here?
questions.answer: It shows deep certainty that the message is true.

questions.question: What word does the passage use for this kind of confirming sign?
questions.answer: A stamp or seal.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how much of humanity is drawn to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: A very large part, more than one-fifth.

questions.question: What feeling do they have when they listen to it?
questions.answer: They listen with eagerness for truth.

questions.question: Who besides humans is said to come around when the Qur'an is recited?
questions.answer: Jinn, angels, and spirit beings.

questions.question: What can we infer from so many different beings gathering around it?
questions.answer: The Qur'an has special honor and wide acceptance.

questions.question: What is a good short summary of the passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s truthfulness and the great welcome given to the Qur'an show it is truly from Allah.
